sources.caption:
🌙 QIYAMULLAIL & SUBUH FUN RUN 🏃‍♂️

Wake up early, seek Allah’s blessings in the last third of the night, and start your day with movement and community spirit!

Join us for a morning of Qiyamullail, Subuh prayer in congregation, and a refreshing 5km fun run through the streets of Kampong Glam.

📅 Saturday, 26 September 2026
🕓 4.00AM – 8.00AM
📍 Masjid Sultan Prayer Hall, Level 1 & 2

✨ Guided by Ustaz Muhammad Zul Fadhli Abdul Razak & Ustaz Hanan Farihin Jasmani
🎽 Dress code for Subuh Fun Run: Proper sports attire
🎁 Freebies & 3 lucky draw prizes to be won!

Scan the QR code or follow the link to register!
🔗bit.ly/SubuhFunRun3

Organised by Masjid Sultan & Geng Malam Jumaat (GMJ)

See you there! 🤲
